decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the construction date of the Bonner House. Document 1 (D1S2) explicitly states 'It was built about 1835'. Document 2 (D2S1 and D2S3) explicitly states 'Built about 1935' and 'It was built about 1935'. As per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat audits as fallible without equating competing assertions, both dates are retained as valid answers derived directly from the source text.
